spec_case: issue #522 acceptance case 12: a chunk whose own plan re-emits the parent's plan is a cycle
description: max_depth: 2, with the threshold tuned so only big and chunk a cross it. a's own planner (prime.big.a.plan) re-emits the parent's exact plan text -> cycle -> a runs as is. Pins the child WARNING for 'a', the prime.big.a.* events, and that the parent (big) still decomposes.
